name: [AddonRepo] Security maintenance of the addon repository toolchain
description:
## Summary

The addon repository toolchain has no defined security-maintenance routine: no named owner for dependency advisories, no cadence for reviewing them, and no documented handling of the deploy credentials and tokens the pipeline holds. The pipeline has write access to published addon output for 58 partner repositories, so a compromised token or an unpatched dependency in the build chain is a supply-chain path into 6,191 live e-shops. This task establishes the routine rather than performing a one-off cleanup: who owns advisories, how often they are triaged, where the tokens live, how they rotate, and who has access. A one-time audit of the current state is part of it, but the deliverable is the standing process, recorded where the duty rota can find it.

## Why?

The pipeline can publish code to partner addons running on thousands of storefronts. Nobody currently owns its dependency advisories or its credentials, so the exposure is unmanaged rather than accepted.

## What?

Dependency advisories for the toolchain have a named owner and a review cadence. Deploy credentials and tokens are inventoried, stored per Shoptet practice, rotatable, and access to them is known. The routine is written down where the duty rota will find it.

## Acceptance Criteria

Dependency advisories for the toolchain have a named owner and a documented review cadence

Current open advisories are triaged, with each one either fixed or explicitly accepted with a reason

Deploy credentials and tokens are inventoried: what exists, where it lives, what it can reach

Every credential can be rotated without a pipeline outage, and the rotation steps are written down

Human access to the credentials is enumerated and reduced to who needs it

The routine is recorded in the team duty runbook

## Technical notes

Credential scope changes with the Vercel migration, so the inventory is worth finalising against the target infrastructure. The advisory routine does not depend on the migration and can start earlier.
